{{Top}}
{{Quote|Please watch what you're doing, Master ''[Oss]'' Wilum! You are millimeters away from my most delicate servos!|A-3DO|<ref name="TotJ4">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''millimeter''' was a unit of length measurement that is equal to one thousandth of a [[Meter/Legends|meter]].
